capabilities: Convert the current note or selected text to MP3 audio
Clean Markdown (frontmatter, tags, links, URLs, embeds, comments) before sending text to TTS
Configure MiniMax, Replicate, or custom HTTP TTS providers
Save generated audio files to the vault and play them in a modal
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copying files into the plugin folder); no screenshots or troubleshooting guidance are provided.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note text into spoken audio files.

relations.evidence: Official Replicate MiniMax Speech 2.8 Turbo preset

requires.name: MiniMax API Key or Replicate API Token

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that converts the current note or selected text into an MP3 file via user-configured TTS APIs and saves it in the vault.
